text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I was walking down the hallway,
I heard the voices of some students.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, what is all this?!
It's totally in the way!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Were these used for an event or something?
There are so many...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking ahead, a huge pile of cardboard boxes was
blocking their path.
It looked difficult to get through.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Darn it, if we don't do something fast,
next period is gonna start!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll blow them away with magic!
Here I go—!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Raging torrent, wash away all in your path!
Chrysanthemum☆Splash!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Stars of the heavens, crush everything below!
Oxypetalum☆Blue Star!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hey, nothing's happening at all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
S-Shut up!
I'm just not in top form today!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Can't be helped then, this looks like
a job for a hero! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wait just a second~!
It's still my turn~!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to save this for later, but...
I guess I have no choice.
—Taste my ultimate secret technique!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho raised her wand high.
I had a feeling this wasn't magic—it was going to be a physical beatdown...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! This is the strongest magic Grandma always used
whenever she got into a fight with Grandpa—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "Ultimate Impact"——!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—WHAM WHAM WHAM WHAM!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if she's young, she's still a horse girl with incredible strength...!
The massive pile of cardboard was shredded to pieces
in the blink of an eye!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! That was awesome, Sweep!
Now we can walk right through!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, that was a piece of cake for a genius magical girl♪
While I'm at it, one more strike—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—Wah, look at the time!?
Oh no, we gotta get to our next class!
choice_data_list: What about all the cardboard scraps...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll clean it up with magic later!
Come on, you two, hurry up~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And away she went...
She did say she'd "clean it up later,"
but leaving it like this felt wrong.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to diligently clean up the mess
before anyone caught sight of it.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: All right, time to clean up—huh?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wah, it's totally spotless~!
Maybe I cast a spell without even realizing it♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hey...!
What do you think you're doing?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—Eek!?
We got busted!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Flower, Biko! Run for it!
We can make a break for it from this distance!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Tch, they got away. —However, you over there,
you seem to know something, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explained the situation to Air Groove and apologized
for not stopping Sweep Tosho from destroying the cardboard.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I see. So that tomboy swept you up in her antics.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even so, the fact remains that you were an accomplice.
You will take proper responsibility for this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nodding at Air Groove's words, I ended up
diligently sweeping up the hallway all by myself...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I heard later on that Sweep Tosho
and the others received a thorough scolding as well.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What, are you trying to stop me?!
choice_data_list: Your ultimate secret technique looks dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, right. There's no telling what might happen
if my magical powers burst out.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, fine then.
I'll solve it with a different spell♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: In that case, minion summoning magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Thistle☆Woodsorrel☆Iris!
You minions, go clean up those cardboard boxes!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ehhh~?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Flower, I folded up the boxes!
What should we do next?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Let's tie them with string. Biko-san,
if you could hold the edge—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's a big help!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For a while, the three of us worked on tidying up the cardboard, but—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Muuu...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Why are you guys having so much fun?!
You're supposed to be my minions~!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fine, then as your master, I'll show you
how it's really done!
Hand that over!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps feeling left out just standing and watching,
Sweep Tosho joined in, and we all ended up cleaning together in the end.
